seo.title: Garden Village Bled: Glamping Treehouse Honeymoon Review
seo.description: Garden Village Bled review. Treehouses & glamping tents minutes from the lake. Score 79/100, from $220/night. Honest 2026 verdict.

content.verdict: Garden Village is the design-led glamping site that put Bled on the boutique-stay map about a decade ago — 27 accommodations split between elevated wooden treehouses (the honeymoon picks), glamping tents on stilts, and pier tents perched above a babbling stream that runs through the property. It is 8 minutes\' walk from Lake Bled itself, set in a private meadow with vegetable gardens, a small natural-water swimming pool, and a kitchen that takes its farm-to-table positioning seriously (most ingredients come from the garden you walk past on the way to dinner). For a couple, the right move is to book a Pier Tent or Treehouse — both come with a private deck, the sound of the stream all night, and very real privacy from neighbours. The aesthetic is Scandinavian-meets-alpine: pale wood, white linen, woollen blankets, hand-thrown ceramic. The food is the surprise — a proper restaurant menu with seasonal Slovenian dishes, paired wines, and a kitchen garden walk on request. The catch: this is glamping, not a hotel. The bathrooms in the treehouses are excellent but the rooms themselves are smaller; the climate from October through April means the open-air aspects close; and the pool is for refreshing dips rather than serious laps. For a honeymoon couple wanting a romantic 2–3 nights of design glamping rather than a grand hotel, this is the most rewarded address in Slovenia.
content.best_room: A Pier Tent above the stream — falling asleep to the water below is the entire reason to be here. For a slight splurge a Premium Treehouse adds more space and a wider deck. Avoid the standard ground-level glamping tents; the elevated rooms are the experience.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival, garden dinner
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive from LJU airport (45 min). Check-in to Pier Tent. Welcome drink in the orchard. Dinner in the garden — kitchen tasting menu.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Bled lake and pletna island
itinerary_7_nights.description: 8-minute walk to Lake Bled. Lake circuit anti-clockwise. Pletna boat to Bled Island, 99 steps. Castle visit sunset, dinner at the castle restaurant.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Vintgar Gorge and lake swim
itinerary_7_nights.description: Early Vintgar Gorge boardwalk. Lake swim afternoon at Mlino beach. Kremšnita at Park Hotel. Sauna evening at Garden Village. Dinner in.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Bohinj day trip
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 25 minutes. Kayak Lake Bohinj. Lunch in Stara Fužina. Vogel cable car. Return for dinner.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Ljubljana day, return to Bled
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 45 minutes to Ljubljana. Walking tour, market, Plečnik. Lunch at Atelje. Afternoon return. Dinner at Mayer.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Hiša Franko in Soča Valley
itinerary_7_nights.description: 90-minute drive through Soča Valley. Lunch at the emerald river. Hiša Franko tasting menu. Overnight Hiša Polonka.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Return drive, departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive back to LJU airport (2 hours) for the afternoon flight home.

caveats: This is glamping, not a 5-star hotel — perfect for 2–3 nights, less so for a full week.
Limited operation outside the warm season (closed roughly November–March).
The pool is small and stream-fed (cool) — not a lounger pool.

faqs.question: Glamping or proper hotel for our honeymoon?
faqs.answer: Best of both — combine 2 nights at Garden Village with 2 nights at Vila Bled or Mayer to get both registers.

faqs.question: How private are the treehouses?
faqs.answer: Genuinely private — set among orchard trees with screening between units. The stream noise masks neighbours entirely.

faqs.question: Is the food really as good as the reviews say?
faqs.answer: Yes — the kitchen takes farm-to-table positioning seriously. The tasting menu is one of the best at this price tier in Bled.

faqs.question: Can you walk to the lake?
faqs.answer: Yes — 8 minutes through a quiet residential lane to the lake circuit. Perfect for an early-morning walk.

faqs.question: When is the best time?
faqs.answer: May through September only. Closed for much of the cold season — verify dates when booking.

faqs.question: Children?
faqs.answer: Allowed and present, especially in summer school holidays — pick another property if you want adults-only quiet.
